title: MathModDB: A Database for Mathematical Models
summary: When researchers need a mathematical model for a research problem, they face a fragmented landscape: relevant formulas, quantities, assumptions, and model variants are scattered across publications and domain-specific conventions. The Mathematical Models Database (MathModDB) addresses this challenge by providing a curated knowledge graph for mathematical models, deployed on the MaRDI Portal as part of the German National Research Data Infrastructure (NFDI).
